en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural settlement with a dirt road curving uphill between wooden fences. In the foreground is a white wooden house with a gabled roof and chimney; a vintage automobile is parked on the road beside it. Another similar house stands further up the hill. Trees line the road on the left. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.
